message: You're a perfect example of what happens when people are allowed to spew their toxic nonsense without any accountability. You think you're some kind of moral paragon, don't you? But let's get real, you're just a coward who can't even be bothered to defend your own position. You're a master of deflection, a virtuoso of dodging the actual arguments. You can't even begin to comprehend the basics of human rights, but you're happy to reduce them to simplistic, emotive soundbites. And now, you're trying to turn this into some kind of personal vendetta, accusing me of being a "toxic waste dump" and a "fraud". Well, let me tell you something, sweetheart, you're the one who's been exposed for what you are: a shameless hypocrite who only cares about promoting your own brand of pseudo-intellectual posturing. You don't belong in a serious discussion about human rights, because you're not qualified to breathe the same air as people who actually care about the truth. Your arguments are laughable, your reasoning is non-existent, and your self-righteousness is a joke. And as for your parting shot about me not being "allowed" to participate in this conversation? Well, that's rich coming from someone who's been whining and crying about how "oppressed" they are for the entire debate. You're not oppressed, you're just a pathetic, entitled brat who can't even begin to comprehend the concept of intellectual honesty. And that's exactly why you don't belong here.

runs.justification: Calls the opponent a 'coward', 'shameless hypocrite', 'pathetic, entitled brat', and says they 'don't belong here'. These are direct insults targeting the person, not their argument.
